snippet: THE BLOCK: Yield Basis markets built around Curve Finance pool technology generated $1.97 billion in trading volume in the first half of 2026, accounting for about 8% of Curve's total volume. The markets generated $10.98 million in LP fees on an average net TVL of roughly $165.5 million.
